name: Test & Measurement
artwork: Original editable TinyCAD vector equipment, probes, sockets, terminals and apparatus. No product photos, logos, traced artwork or imported icon sets.
scope: Compact generic laboratory setup resources, not brand/model replicas or commercial package pinouts. Individual binding posts, screw terminals and bare leads each have one conductor endpoint. BNC/USB/LAN/TC-plug ports are complete cable endpoints; hose ports are complete fluid connections. Endpoint kinds and signal domains are recorded explicitly. No SPICE, instrument measurement, thermal/fluid simulation, automatic internal connections or ratings are provided.

references.title: Keysight E36300 supply front-panel and remote-sense guide
references.facts: Separate output binding posts and remote-sense connections; multi-output supply roles.

references.title: Tektronix ABCs of probes
references.facts: Passive voltage, differential and current probes are different interfaces; probe reference leads are explicit.

references.title: NI differential and single-ended signal wiring
references.facts: Differential acquisition uses positive and negative inputs; signal reference and grounding depend on the source.

references.title: NI USB-6421 overview
references.facts: Multifunction USB acquisition combines differential analog input, analog output, digital I/O and counters.

references.title: DwyerOmega RTD wiring guide
references.facts: Two-, three- and four-wire RTD configurations need distinct explicit lead counts; four-wire separates excitation and sense.

references.title: Fluke temperature calibration practice
references.facts: Probe, reference instrument, bath/dry-block source and controller form common temperature-calibration arrangements.

references.title: IKA hotplate/stirrer technical data
references.facts: Hotplates combine heating/stirring controls and support an external temperature sensor.

references.title: Watlow cartridge/insertion heaters
references.facts: Cartridge/insertion heater assemblies use a metal sheath and separate heater leads.

references.title: Phoenix Contact PLC-RSC-24DC/21 relay module
references.facts: DIN-rail SPDT interface relay with A1/A2 control and 11 common, 12 normally closed, 14 normally open conventions; generic drawing is not a footprint.

references.title: Omron G3NA solid-state relay family
references.facts: Hockey-puck SSR packaging separates control input from load output; load and control variants must be distinguished.

references.title: Julabo laboratory circulators
references.facts: Heating/cooling baths and external circulating loops use separate fluid supply and return connections.

references.title: Pfeiffer vacuum for research
references.facts: Laboratory vacuum systems include dry diaphragm pumps and vacuum measurement.

references.title: Watson-Marlow tubing and peristaltic pumps
references.facts: Rollers drive fluid through tubing; inlet and outlet are hose endpoints rather than electrical contacts.

references.title: Mettler Toledo laboratory balances
references.facts: Balances serve sample preparation and can transfer data through USB or serial interfaces.

references.title: Rohde & Schwarz electronics bench instruments
references.facts: Core bench roles include oscilloscope, multimeter, power supply, signal generator and spectrum analyzer.

references.title: B&K Precision 891 bench LCR meter
references.facts: Bench LCR measurement uses a four-terminal-pair fixture; current and potential coax terminals are distinct.

references.title: Keithley low-level measurements handbook
references.facts: Source-measure units distinguish force, sense and driven guard connections.

sourceReview.decision: Fetched candidates are circuit symbols or an industrial supply block, with incompatible front-panel/physical apparatus geometry and endpoint conventions. Original equipment silhouettes extend the existing physical layout libraries.
